app.name: FlexcityHeadquarters
app.unknownOrg: We couldn't find this organization. Check the web address you were given.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email your organization has on file.
login.locked: Too many attempts. This account is locked for 15 minutes; reset your password to unlock it now.
login.tooMany: Too many sign-in attempts from this device. Wait a few minutes.

board.title: Shift board
board.assigned: Shift claimed. It's now on your schedule.
board.pendingApproval: This shift would add {{hours}} h of overtime, so it has been sent to a supervisor for approval.
board.alreadyClaimed: Someone else claimed this shift first.
board.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
board.description: Open shifts and shifts coworkers are giving away. You only see the ones you're qualified and available for.
board.emptyBody: When a shift opens up that you can work, it appears here and you get a notification.
board.notEligibleHelp: These rules protect you and the people in the water.

status.title: Pool Status
status.pageHelp: They get it right away on their phone.
status.messageHint: For example: "Parent asking about lesson change at the desk."
status.emptyBody: A supervisor adds pools and their permit limits in Settings.

blocks.NOT_QUALIFIED_FOR_POSITION: You're not approved for this position.
blocks.CERTIFICATION_EXPIRES: A required certification expires before this shift ends.
blocks.PREREQUISITE_LAPSED: A prerequisite certification (e.g. first aid) has lapsed.
blocks.OVERLAPPING_SHIFT: You're already working during this time.
blocks.ON_APPROVED_TIME_OFF: You have approved time off during this shift.
blocks.REST_BETWEEN_SHIFTS: You wouldn't get the required rest between shifts.
blocks.DAILY_REST: You wouldn't get the required daily rest.
blocks.UNDER_MINIMUM_AGE: You're under the minimum age for this position.
blocks.YOUNG_WORKER_LIMIT: This would exceed young-worker hour limits.
blocks.OVER_PERSONAL_WEEKLY_MAX: This would exceed your weekly hour cap.

demo.banner: Demo with sample data — nothing you do here is saved.

common.error: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account uses that email, a reset link is on its way. It works for one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.rule: Use at least 10 characters, mixing letters with numbers or symbols.
reset.weak: Use at least 10 characters, mixing letters with numbers or symbols.
reset.expired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one from the sign-in page.

notifications.shift_available: A shift you can take was posted to the board.
notifications.shift_assigned: A shift was added to your schedule.
notifications.shift_covered: Your shift was covered by a coworker.
notifications.shift_unassigned: You were taken off a shift.
notifications.shift_changed: One of your shifts changed time.
notifications.shift_cancelled: One of your shifts was cancelled.
notifications.schedule_published: Your new schedule is out: {{count}} shifts.
notifications.claim_needs_approval: A shift claim needs your approval ({{overtimeHours}} h overtime).
notifications.claim_pending: Your claim was sent to a supervisor because it adds {{overtimeHours}} h of overtime.
notifications.time_off_requested: A time-off request is waiting for you.
notifications.punch_rejected: A punch of yours needs correcting.
notifications.cert_to_verify: A certification is waiting to be verified.
notifications.closure_recommended: Closure recommended: a chemical reading is out of range.

today.noShiftsTitle: No shifts in the next two weeks
today.noShiftsBody: Pick up open shifts from the board, or check back after the next schedule is published.
today.clockHint: Clock in when your shift starts

schedule.title: My schedule
schedule.description: Your shifts for the next four weeks, in each facility's local time.
schedule.posted: Posted to the shift board. You stay responsible until someone takes it.
schedule.emptyBody: Shifts appear here once a supervisor publishes the schedule.

errors.SHIFT_ALREADY_CLAIMED: Someone else took this shift first.
errors.SHIFT_CHANGED: This shift just changed. Refresh to see the latest.
errors.ALREADY_POSTED: This shift is already on the board.
errors.SHIFT_NOT_PUBLISHED: Only published shifts can go on the board.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have access to do that.
errors.VALIDATION: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.
errors.BAD_REQUEST: Some details aren't right. Check the form and try again.
errors.TIME_OFF_OVERLAPS: You already asked for time off during part of these days.
errors.ALREADY_STARTED: This time off has started. Ask your supervisor to change it.
errors.THRESHOLDS_NOT_CONFIGURED: This pool's limits aren't set yet. A supervisor sets them in Settings.
errors.NO_RECOMMENDATION: There's no closure waiting for a decision.
errors.OVERTIME_REQUIRES_ACK: This would add overtime. Confirm to assign anyway.
errors.ASSIGNEE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: The assigned person couldn't work it after this change. Unassign them first.

timeclock.title: Timeclock
timeclock.description: Clock in when your shift starts and out when it ends. Your supervisor reviews punches before payroll.
timeclock.unscheduled: Clock in without a scheduled shift
timeclock.unscheduledHelp: For call-ins and cover. Your supervisor will review it.
timeclock.locationNote: When you clock in we check, once, that you're at the facility. We don't track your location.
timeclock.noPunches: No punches in the last two weeks.

location.OUTSIDE_RADIUS: Clocked in. You seem to be away from the facility, so your supervisor will check this punch.
location.LOW_ACCURACY: Clocked in. Your location was unclear, so your supervisor will check this punch.
location.NO_LOCATION: Clocked in without location. Your supervisor will check this punch.

timeOff.title: Time off
timeOff.description: Ask for time away. If it's approved, your shifts in that time go to the board for others to cover.
timeOff.emptyBody: Requests you send appear here with their answer.
timeOff.protectedHint: You're entitled to this leave under employment standards. You don't need to share medical details.
timeOff.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: When you can work each week. The scheduling assistant only offers you shifts inside these times.
availability.effectiveHint: Earlier weeks keep your old availability.
availability.endBeforeStart: Each time must end after it starts.

lessons.title: Lessons
lessons.description: Take attendance on the deck. It saves on your phone first and uploads when there's signal.
lessons.offline: You're offline. Showing rosters saved at {{time}}. Your marks will upload when you reconnect.
lessons.emptyTitle: No lessons in the next week
lessons.emptyBody: Classes appear here when you're scheduled as the instructor.

ops.title: Pool log
ops.description: Record chemistry and bather counts. Readings outside the permit limits recommend a closure for the head lifeguard to confirm.
ops.recordHelp: Values in ppm. Leave blank what you didn't test.
ops.bathersHint: Used to work out how many guards are needed.
ops.outOfRange: Outside the permit limits. Closure recommended; the head lifeguard has been notified.
ops.dismissPlaceholder: e.g. Retested at 10:15: free Cl 1.8, pH 7.4

done.CONFIRM: Pool closed. The front desk sees it now.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: Reports are encrypted. Opening one asks for a reason and is logged.
incidents.fileHelp: Write what happened while it's fresh. Stick to facts.
incidents.peopleHint: Roles and ages are enough, e.g. "swimmer, about 9".
incidents.filedBody: Your supervisor has it. Thank you for writing it up.
incidents.recentHelp: Only the type, time and place show here.
incidents.none: No incidents in the last 30 days.
incidents.purposeHelp: Opening a report is logged with your reason.

signature.drawArea: Signature area: draw with your finger, stylus or mouse

profile.certAdded: Added. A supervisor will verify it before it counts for shifts.
profile.toSignHelp: Signing confirms you received it. It doesn't mean you agree.
profile.signMeaning: By signing you confirm you received this record. You can ask for a union steward and add your own comments through HR.
profile.addCertHelp: Enter it as shown on your card. Bring the card to a supervisor to have it verified.
profile.expiryHint: Leave empty if it doesn't expire.
profile.reliabilityHelp: Advisory only: never used to schedule or discipline automatically. Sick days and protected leave never count.
profile.noEvents: Nothing recorded in the last 90 days.

events.LATE_DROP: Gave away a shift with under 24 h notice

profile.languageHint: Used for the app, emails and notifications.

builder.title: Schedule builder
builder.description: Build the week, let the assistant suggest people, then publish. Every assignment follows the same rules as the shift board.
builder.emptyBody: Add shifts with the + on each day. They stay as drafts until you publish.
builder.inZone: Times are in the facility's time zone ({{zone}}). An end time before the start runs overnight.
builder.customHint: Shown instead of the position, e.g. "Smith family rental".
builder.assistHelp: It only suggests people who are qualified, available and not going into overtime. Nothing changes until you apply.
builder.published_one: Published {{count}} shift. {{open}} went to the shift board.
builder.published_other: Published {{count}} shifts. {{open}} went to the shift board.
builder.noCandidates: No one is approved for this position yet.
builder.overtimeAsk: This adds {{hours}} h of overtime. Assign anyway? It's recorded in the audit log.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Everything waiting for a supervisor, in one place.
approvals.claimsEmpty: Claims that would add overtime appear here.
approvals.punchesEmpty: Finished punches appear here for review before payroll.

claim.APPROVE: Approved. The shift moved to them.
claim.DENY: Declined. The shift stays on the board.

approvals.protectedNote: This is statutory leave. It usually can't be refused; declining asks for a reason that's recorded.
approvals.reasonHelp: The staff member sees this reason.
approvals.protectedDecline: Statutory sick days and protected leave usually can't be refused. Record why; it's audited.

timeOffDone.APPROVE: Approved. Their shifts in that time went to the board.
timeOffDone.DENY: Declined. They can see your reason.

certs.title: Certifications
certs.description: Verify cards staff added and see who needs to renew. Expired or unverified certifications never count for shifts.
certs.toVerifyHelp: Check the physical card or a photo before verifying.

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Everyone on your team, their roles, positions and certifications.
staff.inviteHelp: They'll get an email to set a password. The link works for 7 days.
staff.dobHint: Only used to apply young-worker rules.
staff.schedulingHelp: Squad, weekly hours and the positions they can work.
staff.addVerifiedHelp: You've seen the original card. It counts right away.
staff.payRatesHelp: Only HR sees pay. A new rate ends the previous one the day before.
staff.newRateHelp: Pick the position and the day the rate starts.
staff.newRecordHelp: They'll be asked to sign that they received it.
staff.summaryHint: Facts only: date, what was observed, what's expected next.
staff.privacyHelp: Erase their personal information once records no longer need to be kept.
staff.erasureHelp: Their name and contact details are removed after the legal retention period. Payroll totals stay. This can't be undone.

payroll.title: Payroll export
payroll.description: Approved hours, overtime, stat holiday and vacation pay, as a CSV for your payroll system.
payroll.periodHelp: Only approved punches are included. Review open punches in Approvals first.
payroll.fixFirstHelp: Your payroll system would reject the file. Nothing was downloaded.
payroll.warningsHelp: The file was built, but these need a look.
payroll.empty: No approved hours in this period. Approve punches first if you expected some.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: How your organization, facilities and pay rules are set up.
settings.payWeekHint: Weekly overtime is counted from this day.
settings.retentionHint: At least 6 years under most provincial rules.
settings.logoUrlHint: A secure (https) link to a PNG or SVG.
settings.unionEnabled: Turn on the Union hub for staff
settings.facilitiesHelp: The province and time zone set the employment rules and clock times for each site.
settings.costCentreHint: Payroll needs this for every facility.
settings.radiusHint: How close staff must be to clock in.
settings.poolsHelp: Water-quality limits from your operating permit. Out-of-range readings recommend a closure.
settings.thresholdsHelp: Enter the limits exactly as your permit or health authority states them.
settings.payCodesHelp: The earnings codes your payroll system uses. Leave a code blank if you don't use it.
settings.positionCodes_one: {{count}} position-specific code is kept as is.
settings.positionCodes_other: {{count}} position-specific codes are kept as is.
settings.calendarHelp: Young workers can't work during school hours on school days. Add terms and breaks so the rules know which days count.
settings.calendarEmpty: No periods yet. Until you add some, every weekday from September to June counts as a school day.
settings.toHint: Leave blank if it has no end.
settings.rulesHelp: Where your collective agreement is better than the provincial minimum. The law still applies where it's better.
settings.addRuleHelp: Each change is effective-dated and logged.
settings.valueHint: Hours, or the multiplier for stat holidays.
settings.agreementSourceHint: The article, so anyone can check it.

jobs.title: Job postings
jobs.description: Openings shown on your public careers page.
jobs.noneHelp: Post an opening and share your careers page link.
jobs.formHelp: Only published postings with a future closing date are public.
jobs.optional: Optional. English is shown if blank.
jobs.payHint: Pay transparency laws in some provinces require a range.
jobs.applyUrlHint: Your application form (https://) or an email (mailto:).
jobs.publicIntro: Lifeguard, instructor and aquatics roles. Apply before the closing date.
